bio.summary: Isaacson is again seeking a Boulder council seat after a previous campaign. Her stated priorities include housing affordability, climate resilience, city government and local businesses.

statements.text: A DDA could be an effective tool, but it needs a clear and transparent investment strategy, meaningful representation for affected stakeholders, and safeguards ensuring that public resources produce measurable public benefits.
statements.speaker: Rachel Rose Isaacson

statements.text: Boulder would benefit from a coordinated, long-term strategy to strengthen Downtown, University Hill, and the Civic Area.
statements.speaker: Rachel Rose Isaacson
statements.source_title: 2026 Mayoral and City Council Candidate Questions — Rachel Rose Isaacson

statements.text: Isaacson said she would have voted against sending a DDA proposal to DDA voters had she been on Council this year when they voted.
statements.speaker: Richard Valenty reporting Rachel Rose Isaacson’s interview

statements.text: Based on where the city is directing significant staff capacity, funding, and Council attention, I would characterize its current top priorities as fiscal sustainability and core services; housing and homelessness; and community safety and climate resilience.
statements.speaker: Rachel Rose Isaacson

statements.text: I would maintain regular office hours and make myself available for contact with our business community.
statements.speaker: Rachel Rose Isaacson
statements.source_title: 2026 Mayoral and City Council Candidate Questions — Rachel Rose Isaacson

statements.text: I believe our response to homelessness must be humane, prevention-focused, and grounded in long-term solutions that make the best use of our limited resources.
statements.speaker: Rachel Rose Isaacson

statements.text: Businesses should expect timely responses to threats, violence, theft, and illegal drug activity, accessible sidewalks and entrances, maintained public spaces, and clear communication about how to obtain help.
statements.speaker: Rachel Rose Isaacson
statements.source_title: 2026 Mayoral and City Council Candidate Questions — Rachel Rose Isaacson
